title: jitso arsenal without jitso/jitso.yaml says each list is open and shows the skill folders and servers that exist
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories (allowlists are open unless a list restricts)
intent: An open list has no names of its own, so arsenal says it is open and prints what a build can point at: the project's skill folders and .mcp.json servers, and the user's skills and servers under their user: names. A user item with the name of a project one is left out, because no build may name it.
